validity.researcher_notes: The branch is real and was launched in November 2022. The sheet length of 54 km differs from the 53 km both sources give, and the change is staged.

fills.researcher_notes: Kurtamysh newspaper of 17 November 2022 says the 53 km branch and the Kurtamysh gas distribution station were launched on 3 November 2022. The sheet status operating stays.
The same report dates the launch to 3 November 2022, so the start year 2022 stands.

Two sources agree on 53 km. The Kurtamysh newspaper of November 2022 says 53 km. The Kurgan Oblast government news of 13 May 2022 also says 53 km. The sheet has 54 km, so the length is changed to 53 km.
